description_en: Queries the memory configurations, memory statistics, and backup summary of agent instances for the current account by using a paged query with paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前账号的 Agent 实例记忆配置、记忆统计和备份摘要
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center list-agent-instance-memory --agent-provider AgenticComputer --agent-platform ENTERPRISE_AGENTIC_COMPUTER --biz-type 1 --search-keyword ecd-d8ut --search-type RESOURCE_ID --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --end-user-ids user01 --excluded-end-user-ids user02 --memory-statuses ENABLED --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAgentInstanceMemory

parameters.help_en: Filters results by agent provider. If this parameter is omitted, the system queries providers that support memory management. `JVSCopilot` is not supported for memory management in this API operation
parameters.help_zh: 按 Agent 提供方筛选。省略时查询支持记忆管理的提供方。`JVSCopilot` 不在此接口的记忆管理范围内
parameters.name: agent_provider

parameters.help_en: Filters results by the business platform to which the agent belongs. If this parameter is omitted, no restriction is applied to the business platform
parameters.help_zh: 按 Agent 所属业务平台筛选。省略时不限制业务平台
parameters.name: agent_platform

parameters.help_en: Filters results by business type code. If this parameter is omitted, no restriction is applied to the business type
parameters.help_zh: 按业务类型编码筛选。省略时不限制业务类型
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: The keyword used for inclusion matching. Use SearchType to specify the search field. If this parameter is left empty, no keyword filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 用于包含匹配的关键词。通过 SearchType 指定搜索字段，留空时不按关键词筛选
parameters.name: search_keyword

parameters.help_en:
The scope of the keyword search. Default value: `ALL`.
`ALL`: Searches resource IDs, resource names, runtime IDs, and end user IDs.
`RESOURCE_ID`: Searches resource IDs.
`RESOURCE_NAME`: Searches resource names.
`RUNTIME_ID`: Searches runtime IDs.
`END_USER_ID`: Searches end user IDs
parameters.help_zh:
关键词搜索范围，默认为 `ALL`。
`ALL`：搜索资源 ID、资源名称、运行环境 ID 和终端用户 ID。
`RESOURCE_ID`：搜索资源 ID。
`RESOURCE_NAME`：搜索资源名称。
`RUNTIME_ID`：搜索运行环境 ID。
`END_USER_ID`：搜索终端用户 ID
parameters.name: search_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数，最多 100 条。默认 100 条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the first page is queried
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始。未传或传入 0 时查询第 1 页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The list of end user IDs to be included in the query results. Exact matching is applied. Maximum value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 要纳入查询结果的终端用户 ID 列表，精确匹配，最多 200 个
parameters.name: end_user_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of end user IDs to be excluded from the query results. Maximum value: 200. When used together with EndUserIds, these users are removed from the inclusion scope
parameters.help_zh: 要从查询结果中排除的终端用户 ID 列表，最多 200 个。与 EndUserIds 同时使用时，从纳入范围中剔除这些用户
parameters.name: excluded_end_user_ids

parameters.help_en:
Filters results by the memory switch configured for the instance.
`ENABLED`: The instance memory switch is turned on.
`DISABLED`: The instance memory switch is turned off.
If both values are passed, instances matching either status are returned
parameters.help_zh:
按实例配置的记忆开关筛选。
`ENABLED`：实例记忆开关已开启。
`DISABLED`：实例记忆开关已关闭。
传入两项时匹配任一状态
parameters.name: memory_statuses

schema.description_en: The response of the API call
schema.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应结果

Data.description_en: The memory configurations and statistics information of the agent instances on the current page
Data.description_zh: 当前页的 Agent 实例记忆配置和统计信息

items.description_en: The memory switch, statistics, and backup summary of a single agent instance
items.description_zh: 单个 Agent 实例的记忆开关、统计和备份摘要

AgentInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the agent instance, which can be used to configure the instance memory switch or clear the instance memory
AgentInstanceId.description_zh: Agent 实例 ID，可用于设置实例记忆开关或清空实例记忆

AgentInstanceStatus.description_en:
The instance lifetime and epoch status of the agent instance.
`UNDEPLOYED`: No deployment.
`DEPLOYING`: Deployment in progress.
`DEPLOYED`: Deployment completed.
`STARTING`: Starting.
`RUNNING`: Running.
`STOPPING`: Stopping.
`STOPPED`: Stopped.
`UNAVAILABLE`: Not active.
`FAILED`: Failed.
`UPGRADING`: Upgrade in progress.
`REBUILDING`: Reset in progress.
`DELETING`: Deleting.
`DELETED`: Deleted
AgentInstanceStatus.description_zh:
Agent 实例生命周期状态。
`UNDEPLOYED`：未部署。
`DEPLOYING`：部署中。
`DEPLOYED`：已部署。
`STARTING`：启动中。
`RUNNING`：运行中。
`STOPPING`：停止中。
`STOPPED`：已停止。
`UNAVAILABLE`：不可用。
`FAILED`：失败。
`UPGRADING`：升级中。
`REBUILDING`：重置中。
`DELETING`：删除中。
`DELETED`：已删除

AgentPlatform.description_en: The business platform to which the agent belongs

BackupCount.description_en: The number of undeleted memory backups for the instance
BackupCount.description_zh: 该实例尚未删除的记忆备份数量，单位为份

EndUserId.description_en: The ID of the end user to which the instance belongs
EndUserId.description_zh: 实例所属终端用户 ID

LastMemoryUpdatedAt.description_en: The time of the last memory update. The time is returned in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss format, with optional fractional seconds. The time value uses the default time zone of the server, and the string does not include a time zone offset. This field is omitted if the last update time is unavailable
LastMemoryUpdatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次记忆更新时间。以年-月-日T时:分:秒的格式返回，可带小数秒。时间值采用服务端默认时区，字符串不携带时区偏移。未取得最近更新时间时省略

LatestBackupAt.description_en: The time of the latest backup. The time is returned in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss format, with optional fractional seconds. The time value uses the default time zone of the server, and the string does not include a time zone offset. This field is omitted if the backup time is unavailable
LatestBackupAt.description_zh: 最近一次备份时间。以年-月-日T时:分:秒的格式返回，可带小数秒。时间值采用服务端默认时区，字符串不携带时区偏移。未取得备份时间时省略

MemoryCount.description_en: The number of memory entries for the instance. This field may be omitted if statistics are unavailable
MemoryCount.description_zh: 实例的记忆条数。统计不可用时可能省略

MemoryEnabled.description_en: The memory switch configured for the instance, returned as a string. A value of `true` indicates that the switch is turned on. A value of `false` indicates that the switch is turned off
MemoryEnabled.description_zh: 实例配置的记忆开关，以字符串返回。`true` 表示开启，`false` 表示关闭

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the runtime environment is located
RegionId.description_zh: 运行环境所在地域 ID

ResourceId.description_en: The ID of the resource associated with the instance

RuntimeId.description_en: The runtime ID of the instance

RuntimeName.description_en: The name of the runtime environment. The name of the associated resource is returned first. If the resource name is unavailable, the instance name is returned
RuntimeName.description_zh: 运行环境名称。优先返回关联资源名称，未取得资源名称时可返回实例名称

UserGroups.description_en: The list of user groups to which the end user belongs
UserGroups.description_zh: 终端用户所属的用户组列表

items.description_en: A user group to which the end user belongs
items.description_zh: 终端用户所属的一个用户组

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the user group

GroupName.description_en: The name of the user group

UserName.description_en: The username of the end user to which the instance belongs
UserName.description_zh: 实例所属终端用户的用户名

UserOrgs.description_en: The list of organizations to which the end user belongs
UserOrgs.description_zh: 终端用户所属的组织列表

items.description_en: An organization to which the end user belongs
items.description_zh: 终端用户所属的一个组织

WyId.description_en: The Wuying user ID of the end user
WyId.description_zh: 终端用户的无影用户 ID

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number. Pages start from 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page used for this query
PageSize.description_zh: 本次查询使用的每页条数

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于排查问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of instances that meet the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的实例总数，单位为个
